title: Gerund, Infinitive, Conditional — Level 5 — Meaning and word relation

items.prompt: "If I had a bicycle, I would ride to school." What does this sentence mean?

visual.text: The speaker does not have a bicycle.

choices.say: The speaker does not have a bicycle.

visual.text: The speaker has a bicycle.

choices.say: The speaker has a bicycle.

visual.text: The speaker rode to school yesterday.

choices.say: The speaker rode to school yesterday.

visual.text: The speaker will buy a bicycle tomorrow.

choices.say: The speaker will buy a bicycle tomorrow.

items.reteach: Type 2 membayangkan hal yang tidak nyata sekarang: kenyataannya ia tidak punya sepeda.

items.prompt: "If Ayu had brought her raincoat, she wouldn't have got wet." What really happened?

visual.text: Ayu did not bring her raincoat and got wet.

choices.say: Ayu did not bring her raincoat and got wet.

visual.text: Ayu brought her raincoat and stayed dry.

choices.say: Ayu brought her raincoat and stayed dry.

visual.text: Ayu brought her raincoat but got wet.

choices.say: Ayu brought her raincoat but got wet.

visual.text: Ayu will bring her raincoat tomorrow.

choices.say: Ayu will bring her raincoat tomorrow.

items.reteach: Type 3 kebalikan dari kenyataan masa lalu: ia tidak membawa jas hujan, jadi basah.

items.prompt: "I wish I didn't live so far from school." Which statement is true?

visual.text: The speaker lives far from school.

choices.say: The speaker lives far from school.

visual.text: The speaker lives near school.

choices.say: The speaker lives near school.

visual.text: The speaker used to live far from school.

choices.say: The speaker used to live far from school.

visual.text: The speaker will move closer next month.

choices.say: The speaker will move closer next month.

items.reteach: Wish + simple past berarti kenyataan sekarang kebalikannya: ia memang tinggal jauh.

items.prompt: Which phrase is closest in meaning to "avoid" in "Try to avoid eating fried snacks every day"?

visual.text: stay away from

choices.say: stay away from

visual.text: look forward to

choices.say: look forward to

visual.text: pay attention to

choices.say: pay attention to

visual.text: get used to

choices.say: get used to

items.prompt: Which expression is the opposite in meaning of "refuse to"?

visual.text: agree to

choices.say: agree to

visual.text: decline to

choices.say: decline to

visual.text: reject

choices.say: reject

visual.text: deny

choices.say: deny

items.reteach: Refuse to = menolak; lawannya agree to = setuju untuk.

items.prompt: "Dimas gave up playing online games." What does "gave up" mean here?

visual.text: stopped doing

choices.say: stopped doing

visual.text: started doing

choices.say: started doing

visual.text: enjoyed doing

choices.say: enjoyed doing

visual.text: continued doing

choices.say: continued doing

items.reteach: Give up + gerund = berhenti melakukan sesuatu.

items.prompt: "The teacher let us use calculators." Which sentence has the same meaning?

visual.text: The teacher allowed us to use calculators.

choices.say: The teacher allowed us to use calculators.

visual.text: The teacher forced us to use calculators.

choices.say: The teacher forced us to use calculators.

visual.text: The teacher stopped us from using calculators.

choices.say: The teacher stopped us from using calculators.

visual.text: The teacher reminded us to bring calculators.

choices.say: The teacher reminded us to bring calculators.

items.reteach: Let = mengizinkan (allow). Perhatikan: allow + objek + to-infinitive.

items.prompt: "The coach made us run around the field." Which sentence has the closest meaning?

visual.text: The coach forced us to run around the field.

choices.say: The coach forced us to run around the field.

visual.text: The coach allowed us to run around the field.

choices.say: The coach allowed us to run around the field.

visual.text: The coach ran around the field with us.

choices.say: The coach ran around the field with us.

visual.text: The coach stopped us from running around the field.

choices.say: The coach stopped us from running around the field.

items.reteach: Make + objek + verb 1 = memaksa/menyuruh (force someone to do).

items.prompt: "Unless you water the plants, they will die." This sentence means …

visual.text: If you don't water the plants, they will die.

choices.say: If you don't water the plants, they will die.

visual.text: If you water the plants, they will die.

choices.say: If you water the plants, they will die.

visual.text: If you hadn't watered the plants, they would have died.

choices.say: If you hadn't watered the plants, they would have died.

visual.text: Although you water the plants, they will die.

choices.say: Although you water the plants, they will die.

items.prompt: What is the Indonesian meaning of "I wish I had listened to my mother"?

visual.text: Seandainya dulu aku mendengarkan ibuku.

choices.say: Seandainya dulu aku mendengarkan ibuku.

visual.text: Aku berharap akan mendengarkan ibuku.

choices.say: Aku berharap akan mendengarkan ibuku.

visual.text: Aku sedang mendengarkan ibuku.

choices.say: Aku sedang mendengarkan ibuku.

visual.text: Aku selalu mendengarkan ibuku.

choices.say: Aku selalu mendengarkan ibuku.

items.reteach: Wish + past perfect = penyesalan tentang masa lalu (seandainya dulu …).

items.prompt: "Sinta is considering joining the drama club." What does "considering" mean here?

visual.text: thinking about

choices.say: thinking about

visual.text: refusing

choices.say: refusing

visual.text: finishing

choices.say: finishing

visual.text: remembering

choices.say: remembering

items.reteach: Consider + gerund = mempertimbangkan (thinking about doing something).

items.prompt: Choose the best English for "Ayah berhenti minum kopi manis demi kesehatannya."

visual.text: Father stopped drinking sweet coffee for his health.

choices.say: Father stopped drinking sweet coffee for his health.

visual.text: Father stopped to drink sweet coffee for his health.

choices.say: Father stopped to drink sweet coffee for his health.

visual.text: Father stopped drink sweet coffee for his health.

choices.say: Father stopped drink sweet coffee for his health.

visual.text: Father stopped drank sweet coffee for his health.

choices.say: Father stopped drank sweet coffee for his health.

items.reteach: Stop + gerund = berhenti melakukan. Stop + to-infinitive = berhenti untuk melakukan hal lain.

items.prompt: Compare "I remember locking the door" and "Remember to lock the door." What is the difference?

visual.text: The first is about a past action; the second is about a task to do.

choices.say: The first is about a past action; the second is about a task to do.

visual.text: The first is about a task to do; the second is about a past action.

choices.say: The first is about a task to do; the second is about a past action.

visual.text: Both mean the same thing.

choices.say: Both mean the same thing.

visual.text: Both talk about the future.

choices.say: Both talk about the future.

items.reteach: Remember + gerund = ingat pernah melakukan. Remember + to-infinitive = ingat untuk melakukan.

choices.say: decided
